509963.risk_area: Zip-slip path traversal in archive extraction
509963.evidence: Local PoC: crafted zip with '../../../pwned-marker-file.txt' member extracted via `python3 -m zipfile -e` writes outside targetDir (confirmed in sandbox). `unzip` fallback strips ../ (safe), but the python fallback in code has no entry-name validation. Sink: workspace-manager.ts:1017-1027.

d1277b.risk_area: Path traversal via unsanitized skill/agent name from DB
d1277b.evidence: Confirmed and reported as vuln-0004: executed local vitest PoC with synthetic marker shows escape via downloadSkill/generateAgentSubagentFiles/installSkillToWorkspace; contrast control (readWorkspaceFile containment, doc-group name sanitization) proves missing guard, not missing pattern.

history.evidence: Skill and agent names are free-form strings (skills.routes.ts POST body has no regex/refine; agent schema only min/max length). No startsWith containment check on skillDir in downloadSkill (workspace-manager.ts:970) unlike readWorkspaceFile. Cross-tenant attack requires knowing another scope's skill name; unvalidated join is confirmed statically. No runtime repro executed.

4af98b.risk_area: Path traversal in workspace file read/write
4af98b.evidence: join + startsWith(workspacePath) prefix check present on every workspace read/write/resolve path (lines 1476, 1555, 1569, 1605). No decodeURIComponent on path before join (single decode at Fastify router level), null-byte risk is theoretical only. Prefix check is string-prefix (not boundary-aligned) but workspacePath always ends at a sessionId segment, so no sibling-prefix collision in practice.

7c895d.evidence: Filename sanitized with replace(/[/\\:*?"<>|]/g,'-') removing both separators; Date.now() prefix; join into org-scoped kb dir. No traversal component can survive.

e45b9d.risk_area: Path traversal via packId/scopeDirName route params
e45b9d.evidence: GET /api/packs/onboarding/:packId/:scopeDirName and POST /api/packs/deploy pass raw params into join(baseDir, 'industry-pack-'+packId) and join(packDir,'scopes',scopeDirName) with no traversal check (pack-deploy.service.ts:97-100, 214-220). No zip extraction exists in pack deploy (no unzip usage); traversal is readFile-only disclosure within same filesystem, authenticated any org user.

f988f0.evidence: validateFileAccess enforces `${orgId}/` prefix on download/delete/metadata; upload sanitizes filename to [a-zA-Z0-9.-]. Property tests (file-storage-isolation.property.test.ts) cover cross-org denial and key prefix. Minor: prefix check is string-based (org "a" vs "ab" keys) but org IDs are UUIDs in practice.

79c7b0.evidence: Filenames are server-generated (Date.now + random); user upload re-encoded via sharp to WebP; S3 only, no filesystem paths from user input.

dcf3c1.risk_area: Command injection / traversal in AgentCore container file ops
dcf3c1.evidence: sanitizePath (agentcore-command.service.ts:214-219) rejects '..' and leading '/' and backtick/$/;/|/&/< > before shell use on every readFile/writeFile/deleteFile/syncFileFromS3 path; content is written via quoted heredoc (no terminator injection since AGENTCORE_HEREDOC_EOF is unique-ish); syncFileFromS3 interpolates only server-derived bucket/key and the sanitized path.

1bc4c7.surface: workspace-manager.ts doc group symlinks / installPlugins / marketplace install localPath
1bc4c7.risk_area: Symlink and copy-source boundary crossing into session workspaces
1bc4c7.evidence: Doc-group symlink names sanitized; targets are server-computed storagePath UUIDs. Plugin names come from DB (org-scoped); skill localPath is server-derived data/skills/{hashId}. Marketplace 'npx skills add' fetches remote content but is an authenticated install-by-design feature (documented), and skillDir is hash-based.

62bdb1.risk_area: Zip-slip / path traversal in archive extraction
62bdb1.evidence: PoC invoked the real private method via tsx with a zip containing entry "../../../../tmp-pwned-marker-<rand>.txt": the unzip branch ('unzip -o') stripped "../" components (landed inside targetDir), and the python3 -m zipfile -e fallback (Python 3.14) also sanitized the name (".." replaced with "_", absolute components stripped) so the marker landed inside targetDir, never outside. Symlink-entry variant also failed in both branches (unzip defers symlink creation after directory writes; Python branch raises NotADirectoryError). Caller path downloadSkill (line 999) performs no zip-entry validation but none is required given both extraction utilities sanitize. Production image (backend/Dockerfile, node:20-alpine, apk adds only openssl/curl) contains no python3 and no unzip — extraction falls to the error branch. No traversal path demonstrated on any reachable runtime.

d89fb0.evidence: Vitest PoC (tests/unit/pack-deploy-traversal.poc.test.ts) with real service + routes: URL-encoded traversal in packId='a/../../' and ../-chain in scopeDirName read a marker onboarding.json outside industry-packs/, returned to any authenticated user. Filed as vuln-0001. Impact ceiling: fixed appended filenames only (onboarding.json/scope.json/sop.md/SKILL.md etc.); auth preHandler enforced (401 control test). POST /api/packs/deploy shares the identical join pattern; deploy-side traversal not separately exercised (DB mocked) but same root cause.

cfea2c.evidence: PoC tests/unit/kb-idor.poc.test.ts: real route handlers + service with where-clause-faithful prisma mock; org A member read/modified/deleted org B KB, files, folders; 9/9 tests green. Filed as vuln-0002.

216e9c.evidence: Same PoC file, C4 block: org A user read org B briefings, marked read, archived; 3/3 green. Filed as vuln-0003.

8633b3.surface: workspace-manager.ts skill/agent name path joins (downloadSkill, generateAgentSubagentFiles, installSkillToWorkspace, syncSkills)
8633b3.evidence: Confirmed with local vitest PoC against the real WorkspaceManager (mock S3): skill name '../../../../../../escaped-skill' writes SKILL.md outside the skills dir; agent name with ../ writes agent .md outside agents dir; installSkillToWorkspace copies a skill tree outside the workspace. No name validation in skills.routes.ts/skill.service.ts or agent.schema.ts (length-only); DB imposes no format constraint; readWorkspaceFile:1474-1476 has the containment check these sinks lack. Filed as vuln-0004.

d9b881.evidence: No authenticate preHandler on either route; no global auth in app.ts. Local vitest PoC (tests/unit/avatar-routes.authz.poc.test.ts) shows anonymous generation succeeds when flag on. Filed vuln-0005.

154905.risk_area: Cross-user avatar access / missing object-level authorization
154905.evidence: Presign route requires auth but binds no owner/org check — any authenticated user can presign any key (PoC passed). The /avatars/* proxy is fully unauthenticated and streams any avatars/* key (PoC passed, synthetic marker). Keys are non-enumerable (Date.now + random), impact limited to avatar image reads; also multi-segment keys passed to /presign/ route fall through to the unauthenticated wildcard proxy, bypassing its auth check. Severity is hardening-level (low); not filed as separate report due to turn budget — parent should assess whether to file as low-severity.

935f9d.risk_area: IDOR / unauthenticated access in avatar upload/download
935f9d.evidence: Root-agent read of avatarRoutes.ts + routes/index.ts:196 (prefix /api, no global auth hook in app.ts — but see below). /avatars/generate* lack `authenticate` preHandler, however gated behind ENABLE_AVATAR_GENERATION==='true' (default off) and only write generated avatars to a global namespace — an unauthenticated cost/state-change issue only when the env flag is enabled; not enabled by default. /avatars/presign/:key and the /avatars/* proxy serve any key under the shared avatars/ prefix with no ownership binding — cross-user avatar image read only; keys are `avatars/${Date.now()}-${random36}.webp` (unguessable in practice). Impact ceiling is disclosure of another user's avatar image if its key is known — a hardening gap, not a demonstrable vulnerability (no enumeration vector). Treating as hardening note, not a filed finding.
